name: crosstalk bridge
description: The four bulk writes crosstalk needs that Dispatcharr's REST API cannot do: stream-list assignment, stream stats, clearing a channel's group, and generated guide entries. Every request is HMAC-signed with a secret crosstalk generates; nothing here reads, deletes channels, or runs anything else.
author: crosstalk

fields.label: How this works
fields.description: crosstalk calls this plugin through Dispatcharr's plugin-run API. Paste the secret printed by `crosstalk bridge secret` below and enable the plugin. There are no buttons: every action needs a signed request from crosstalk.

fields.label: Secret
fields.placeholder: paste the output of `crosstalk bridge secret`
fields.help_text: At least 32 characters. Requests signed with anything else are refused. Ignored while CROSSTALK_BRIDGE_SECRET is set in Dispatcharr's environment, which keeps the secret out of the database (see docs/bridge.md).

fields.label: Previous secret (rotation)
fields.help_text: While rotating: the old secret, still accepted until the time below. Clear it once every crosstalk instance uses the new one. Ignored while CROSSTALK_BRIDGE_PREVIOUS_SECRET is set.

fields.label: Accept the previous secret until
fields.help_text: An ISO 8601 UTC time or unix seconds. Empty or past: the previous secret is refused. Ignored while CROSSTALK_BRIDGE_GRACE_UNTIL is set.

fields.label: EPG sources guide writes may use
fields.help_text: Comma-separated EPG source ids crosstalk may write generated guide entries and programmes into. Empty refuses every guide write.
